proposals.evidence: Turner *varta round stone explicitly includes Bihari baṭṭā stone roller for spices, grindstone, beside Punjabi baṭṭā stone. The central/northern survey baṭṭa/baṭṭā pestles match this grinding-stone noun; source-separated t t transcriptions are retained unchanged. This is not vartaka 11349, whose cited reflexes mean clod, pill or egg.
